I've been reading Hitler's War by David Irving and it a really well written account of events within the 3rd Reich based solely on documentation from the Allies and Germany. There's no opinion or propaganda, just facts based on letters, diaries, communications, meetings and conversations usually recorded by secretaries all in the form of a chronological story from the beginning to the end. It really digs into every aspect of what was going on in the government. All the betrayals, the coups, the plots and missions. It has a lot of personal information you wouldn't normally get about the people involved. It also makes Germany seems less like a mythical beast and more like a nation fighting for what everyone wanted at the time which was national unity and freedom to be self-determinant.
